bug.title: Appeal polish: every /mod viewer is told they are on the panel; overturn notice shows a raw CID; post appeals never say what was hidden; raw dates and outcome words
bug.symptoms: Every appeal card on /mod says "You're on the appeal panel for ..." to whoever views it, including the moderator who made the decision (apps/web/src/features/mod-console/appeal-card.tsx prints it unconditionally) After the panel overturns a hide, the author's notice reads "A moderator made a decision on your post. Appeal bafyreihbxuez5x3q... was overturned by the panel; this decision restores the hidden record." - raw CID overflowing the card, credits a moderator, names no paper An appeal against a hidden post: the card says "You're on the appeal panel for a moderation decision" / "Appeal of a moderation decision" / "hide under policy MOD-09" with no post excerpt or paper title, and offers "Read the paper"; the attention item says only "Vote on an appeal panel by 2026-12-02."; a non-voting member gets "The panel decided: overturned." naming nothing Notices say "You voted upheld/overturned" (raw outcome words; the card says "Uphold the decision"); attention items print deadlines as "2026-12-02" Opening a panel notice scrolls the appeal's heading under the sticky header (the first visible line is "DECISION APPEALED"); the card repeats the paper title in the panel line and the heading A member who reported the post was drawn onto the panel hearing the appeal against the decision on that report
bug.expected: The appeals API returns, per appeal, whether the viewer is a panel member (and their vote), and describes the appealed decision's target (record type, paper title, post/review excerpt); the card shows "You're on the appeal panel" only to panel members, names what was decided ("Hidden post on '{title}': '{excerpt}'", with "Read the post" linking to it in its thread, or "Read the paper" for versions), and states the title once; the target heading has scroll-margin-top clearing the sticky header so the panel line is visible after navigation; panel draws exclude the decision's moderator, the record's author and every reporter whose flag the decision settled; outcome notices read in words with the subject named and no CID ('The appeal panel overturned the decision to hide your post on "{title}"; it is visible again.', 'The panel upheld the decision on "{title}".', 'You voted to uphold the decision on the appeal for "{title}".'); every attention item and notice formats dates with the shared formatter ("2 Dec 2026") and names its subject
bug.actual: Misleading panel claim; raw ids, words and dates; unnamed subjects

bug.title: Hidden-post appeal UI: double period, unlabelled grounds field, post count ignores what is shown
bug.symptoms: The hidden-post line ends "...clarified.. Appeal" (double period); the appeal grounds box is a small unlabelled field squeezed next to the button The thread count says "1 post" while two posts show (a hidden placeholder and a visible post)
bug.expected: The reason sentence is joined without doubled punctuation; Appeal opens a labelled form (label "Why should this decision be reconsidered?", textarea at full width, character guidance, submit and cancel) in the same style as the paper-hold appeal dialog; the count wording matches what is listed ("1 post, 1 hidden")

bug.title: Whole-archive verify ends "VERIFIED (status: retracted)"; a new version is flagged 45% similar to its own v1
bug.symptoms: `scholium verify archive.car` on a node export ends "Result: VERIFIED (status: retracted)", carrying one paper's status so the whole archive reads as retracted In the moderation queue a paper's v2 shows 45.2% similarity, measured against the same paper's v1, which a moderator could read as plagiarism
bug.reproduction_steps: Journey 09 step 5 (offline check output); journey 13 step 4 (queue text before screenshots/13-new-version-and-review-update/04e-priya-lists-v2.png)
bug.expected: For a multi-paper archive the result line reads "Result: VERIFIED - {n} papers ({k} listed, {r} retracted, ...)" while single-paper output keeps its status; similarity checks exclude earlier versions of the same paper (they may report "differs from v{n-1} by X%" as a separate, labelled fact)

bug.title: Sidebar content still 4px wider than the sidebar; update form report hint outdated; recovery page labels the account by ORCID iD
bug.symptoms: aside.ppg-margin content is 347px inside a 343px sidebar; it no longer scrolls but is clipped, so the right edge of the "Verified · 2 author signatures across 2 versions" pill and the "Anchor pending" line are cut at the edge The update form's report hint still says "Your report is published with the rubric when the review is revealed" (the footer is correct) The person recovering their account sees it labelled by ORCID iD rather than by their profile name
bug.expected: The margin column's children fit its content box at every width from 1024px (min-width: 0 / max-width: 100% / box-sizing on the pill and rows; a CSS test asserts no fixed widths exceed the track); the update form's report hint matches the footer (published now for scores/recommendation, the written report per the version's gate); the recovery page names the account by profile name when one exists (ORCID iD secondary)
